description: This PHP source file defines the 'ViewHistory' class, which manages the display and restoration of historical layout versions within the ModuleBuilder component of SuiteCRM. It includes methods for displaying history, previewing specific snapshots, restoring layouts to previous states, and handling different view types.

classes.name: ViewHistory
classes.description: Handles the display, preview, and restoration of layout history snapshots within the SuiteCRM ModuleBuilder. Provides methods to browse history entries, preview specific snapshots, restore layouts to previous states, and manage user interactions related to layout versioning.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns parameters for the module title, including translated module name and module title, used in the page header.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Main entry point to display the history view. Determines layout, subpanel, and package context, then initializes the parser and fetches the history.

methods.name: browse
methods.description: Displays a paginated list of layout snapshots, with date-time formatting and navigation controls.

methods.name: preview
methods.description: Previews a specific layout snapshot, restoring it temporarily and rendering the appropriate view based on layout type.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores a specific layout snapshot as identified by its timestamp ID.

methods.name: unrestore
methods.description: Undoes the last restore operation, reverting to the previous layout state.
